_comment: PictureBook V3 quality presets (design section 18). Edit this file to retune a preset - no Java
change is needed. Read through org.cote.accountmanager.olio.illustration.QualityPresets, which
keys on PbQualityPresetEnumType; the enum is only the key, these are the values.
resolutionScale  multiplier on the style's page format (0.5 = half-size draft).
stepsMode        'low' | 'default' | 'high' - resolved against the model family's
recommendedSteps in capabilities.json (P2-2), never a fixed step count here.
variants         terminal artifacts per attempt (design section 23, built 2026-10-29, Phase 6 P6-2):
PbNodeExecutor.renderPlanned runs the plan's whole stage sequence N times in a row,
variant i seeded seed0 + i from the renderer's reported seed for variant 0, and persists
N artifacts sharing `attempt` with variantIndex 0..N-1 (only index 0 is auto-selected).
It is NOT images-per-stage: each StageRequest still asks for 1 image. The count comes
from this preset only; no per-request override exists yet (Implementation section 6.C 212 c).
upscale          whether the plan appends an UPSCALE stage.
qa               OFF | CANONICAL (the canonical variant only) | ALL.
defaultPreset is the pre-selection for a new style and for a style whose qualityPreset reads
NULL/UNKNOWN (design section 34 item 7, recorded as a default in PictureBookV3Implementation.md
section 6.C 149 a). A book with NO style at all is a different case - section 29 says STANDARD -
and that lives in the resolver, not here.
qaModel is the vision model VlmQaProvider asks for on the run's chat route (design section 17,
Implementation section 6.C 220 e) - never the chat config's own model, which is a text model. It must
be listed by the route's /api/tags (Ollama) or /v1/models; when it is not, QA reports UNAVAILABLE and
the render is unaffected. Measured on .42 2026-10-30 (section 15.2): valkyriesys/eudaimonia-dryad3-vision
(qwen3vl 8.8B, thinking) answers in ~31 s only with a raised token budget (8192, VlmQaProvider.MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS;
4096 was exhausted) - its Modelfile caps num_predict at 1024 and the whole cap goes to thinking;
qwen3-vl:8b-instruct answers in ~20 s. Alternate: qwen3-vl:8b-instruct.
